items.text: **Questions for the Core classes from `debug` onwards, alphabetically, as many per session as fit** (`rule:testing/website-pages-are-stamped`): dump `bun nv site --questions --owed core --limit 2000` to `.agent-tmp/`, split it into about five groups of 35 to 45 pages by class, and send one general-purpose subagent per group. Each writes `{ url: [questions] }` to its own scratch file. Read every file yourself, merge, then `--questions --stamp` the URLs. Four to six questions per page, at most 15 words, no other language's function names, no word from the user-text table ("refused" slipped in twice), no question repeated word for word on two pages. Next classes: `debug`, `decimal`, `encoding`, `env`, `fatal`, `hash`, `hash-stream`, `heap`, `html`, `http*`, `io*`, `json`, `jwe*`, `jwt*`, `ldap*`. Anchor: `website/src/data/questions.json:1`, the material from `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:486`.
